fieldValues.title: Membership and quorum
fieldValues.article_text: Members: Builder (agent:editor-builder), Reviewer (agent:editor-reviewer), Steward (agent:editor-steward), each running under its own SRS_ACTOR; the owner is the parent role. Quorum for a merge: the builder plus a different reviewer, as two distinct actors, with green gates. The group never self-reviews: a run or session never reviews a PR it built itself. Local Claude Code sessions act as members under the same rules as routines (owner decision f799b6bc, proposed). A group session ratifies its builders' within-mandate decisions (owner decision 70a05a5c, proposed).
fieldValues.rationale: Keeps the review independent even though all actors share one GitHub identity (owner ruling D7, 2026-10-09).
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Owner only: an amendment needs a new owner-ratified decision.
fieldValues.protected_status: Agent testimony until the owner ratifies the charter decision.
